skill_name: Generate a policy recommendation to address youth unemployment.
workflow: To address the issue of youth unemployment, policy makers should focus on investing in proper education and skills training. This will enable young people to gain the necessary skills and qualifications to compete in the modern job market. In addition, initiatives should be taken to actively attract employers and businesses with incentives such as tax cuts and subsidies in order to create more job opportunities for young people.
